entry.title: Warwick Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Two inspected pictures confirm polygonal Guy tower, lobed Caesar tower, clocked twin-turret gatehouse, castellated domestic ranges and stepped motte/ramparts. Retained mapped outline/court and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale and northeast gate/river-side orientation. A6m downward derivative offset puts the reconstructed court at Y5 above the PMTiles working datum. Bounded lower footing vertices extend below coarse terrain; court, bank and stepped motte remain an explicit approximate reconstruction. Anchor -1.585265184,52.279577946; heading 0.789464883642; standard PMTiles datum 63.38437334827418m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
